_comment: Buster - Conversational, Original Eric (ElevenLabs Voice Library, added to My Voices by the user on 2026-11-05). Technical base: young_storyteller.json (not changed). Test profile - not used for production yet. Previous version (eleven_v3): scripts/voice/_backup/2026-11-05_before-buster-v4/buster.json.

elevenlabs._voice_id_note: Confirmed 2026-11-05 via GET /v1/voices/PmelHiOxd6s1PUEdOmwF: HTTP 200, category 'professional' (PVC), sharing status 'copied', no verification needed, notice period 730 days.
elevenlabs._model_note: Changed from eleven_v3 on 2026-11-05: Buster is fine-tuned for eleven_v4 (and multilingual_v2, turbo/flash) but not for eleven_v3. eleven_v4 understands the same inline audio tags as v3 (e.g. [whispers], [softly]), so narration_v2_expressive.txt can stay as it is. Not yet tested: whether v4 returns character timings from /with-timestamps.
elevenlabs._natural_note: 2026-11-05: aim = Buster's own natural conversational sound (like his library sample). Stability 0.53 = his own default. Use spoken texts WITHOUT audio tags and without '…' pauses. Previous version: scripts/voice/_backup/2026-11-05_before-buster-natural/buster.json.
elevenlabs._voice_settings_note: Eleven v4 uses only Stability and Similarity (official docs: 'Style and Speed sliders are not available in Eleven v4'), so style/speed/speaker boost are not sent. Lower stability = more expressive. clone_strength (only for PVCs fine-tuned for v4) is left at the ElevenLabs default (docs: 'For most voices, start at 0%'). Buster's own defaults: stability 0.53, similarity 0.75.

postprocess._note: Natural Buster, no effects: no pitch shift, no formant processing, no tempo change, no EQ, no loudness change. With pitch 0 and tempo 1.0 process_voice.py skips Rubber Band completely; the only remaining step is the format conversion MP3 -> 48 kHz / 24-bit mono WAV that the mix needs.
